status: versioned evidence registry; numerical model parameters live only in src/config/modelParameters.json

rainwater_harvesting.label: Rainwater harvesting
rainwater_harvesting.mechanism: Capture roof runoff before it reaches hillside streets or uncontrolled drainage paths.
rainwater_harvesting.model_role: Physical opportunity uses roof footprint; hazard-weighted exposure enters separately in the decision objective.
rainwater_harvesting.confidence: medium for first-principles captured-volume accounting; low for translation to slope-risk benefit
rainwater_harvesting.pilot_localization_requirements: Local tank sizes, unit/project costs, participation assumptions, and locally appropriate runoff-to-risk effect ranges.

drainage_upgrade.label: Drainage / water management
drainage_upgrade.mechanism: Increase controlled conveyance and reduce uncontrolled surface-water concentration.
drainage_upgrade.model_role: Current opportunity proxy uses mapped access-corridor length only. It is not a drainage-capacity map.
drainage_upgrade.confidence: explicit planning prior until asset-level drainage data and engineering assumptions are supplied locally
drainage_upgrade.pilot_localization_requirements: Define concrete intervention typologies and local cost/effect distributions.

restoration_bioengineering.label: Restoration / soil bioengineering
restoration_bioengineering.mechanism: Vegetation and soil-bioengineering can reduce erosion and add root reinforcement; hydrological effects are site-specific.
restoration_bioengineering.model_role: Opportunity uses open-space and slope proxies; hazard-weighted exposure enters separately.
restoration_bioengineering.confidence: explicit planning prior for effect size; maturity and site dependence remain explicit
restoration_bioengineering.pilot_localization_requirements: Locally appropriate techniques/species, maturity assumptions, and uncertainty distributions.

optimizer.reason: Avoid false cost precision until local evidence can be decomposed into comparable intervention cost distributions.
optimizer.browser_method: Marginal robust greedy selection across climate and intervention-effect uncertainty.
optimizer.formal_checkpoint: Binary MILP over linearized robust-benefit coefficients; stacked effects must be re-evaluated in the nonlinear scenario engine.
